verdict.rationale: Rootly documents overrides as part of its schedule management, and its pricing page lists "Mobile shift swaps and overrides," which points to engineer-initiated swaps and overrides from the mobile app. The evidence is a thin marketing bullet plus a schedules summary, though, with no detail on whether non-admins can do this themselves. Missing for 10: any evidence of a request-coverage flow, documentation that engineers can do this without admin permissions, step-by-step swap/override docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can take an override, swap a shift, or request coverage without an admin rebuilding the schedule

citations.quote: Create, manage, and maintain on-call schedules in Rootly with rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions, and previews to keep coverage clear and predictable.
